notes.title: Dialogue redesign??!!! IS THAT LEGAL?
notes.content:
[h3]hiiiiiiii nice people! ^•ᴥ•^[/h3][p]it's been again some time and i would like to update y'all on the progress we've been doing[/p][p]I've been designing UI of the game past few months on the background in the bits i have inbetween my job and had inbetween my school.  This is one of the bits specifically dialogue. We'll be testing it but our goal is to get it closer looking like a comic book you can click through and see characters reactions in. I think it's going to expand a lot of the things and scenes previously in the DEMO. [/p][p]We're actively developing the game and making changes to it, so expect some previews down the line, I'm very excited!

[b]Estimated date of release is at around Q4 2025.[/b] (Oct–Dec). Please "bear" with us while we make sure everything is polished and made. I also wanna say that more and more cool things we will be showing throughout the development for anyone on our discord server, so stay tuned!![/p][p][/p][p]thanksies so much for being so patient, you're the real spiritflame ultra mega awesome dawgs ^˶>ᴥ<˶^[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188584/88e65ce5ba20f30e6067dc8992331ae36a161e51.png"][/img][/p]
